name: Inworld AI
summary: Voice and model APIs for developers building consumer apps: realtime text-to-speech, speech-to-text, voice cloning and realtime conversation, pay as you go or on monthly plans.
best_for: developers and product teams building consumer apps with realtime voice, who want text-to-speech, speech-to-text and voice cloning through one API and can start pay as you go before committing to a plan
skip_if: you want a finished voiceover tool with an editor rather than an API; or you need guaranteed zero data retention on a mid-tier plan, which the docs tie to Enterprise
honest_knock: The bill is usage on top of the plan, counted on every input character including spaces, punctuation and tags. Credits roll over only while you stay subscribed, cancelling or downgrading forfeits the rest, and payments are non-refundable. The pricing page and the docs disagree on whether zero data retention is a Growth add-on or Enterprise only, and it does not cover requests sent to third-party model providers.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-15 on inworld.ai/pricing, the billing and concurrency pages of docs.inworld.ai and the terms at inworld.ai/terms; the page shows $ without naming a currency) Inworld sells voice and model APIs: text-to-speech, speech-to-text and realtime conversation. On-Demand is $0 and pay as you go: the billing docs say it includes up to 70 minutes of text-to-speech and 400 minutes of speech-to-text free, after which Realtime TTS-2 costs $25 per million input characters, TTS-2 Flash $15 and STT 1 $0.15 an hour of audio. The monthly plans lower those rates and raise the limits. Creator is $25 a month, with 500 custom voices and 4 professional clones, TTS-2 at $20 and Flash at $10 per million characters. Builder is $100 a month, with 3,000 voices and 10 clones, TTS-2 at $17.50 and Flash at $9. Developer is $300 a month, with 10,000 voices, 25 clones and priority email, TTS-2 at $15 and Flash at $8. Growth is $1,500 a month, with 30,000 voices and 40 clones, TTS-2 at $12.50 and Flash at $7, and lists zero data retention, HIPAA and a BAA as add-ons. Speech-to-text is $0.10 an hour on every paid plan. Enterprise has custom prices, limits and terms. Paid plans come with credits used across API and Playground products; subscription credits roll over for up to 3 months while an eligible paid plan stays active, and extra credits, bought by hand or by auto-reload, expire a year after purchase. The pricing page also has a yearly view with lower monthly figures, which we did not confirm. Text-to-speech is counted on input characters, including spaces, punctuation and tags that are not spoken.

compare_with.name: ElevenLabs
compare_with.why: ElevenLabs is in our dossiers too and is the broader voice platform, with voiceovers, dubbing, audiobooks and conversational agents next to its API: its cheapest paid tier, Starter, was $6 a month billed monthly when we read it on 23 September 2026, the first with a commercial licence. Inworld is narrower and built for developers, priced as pay as you go from $0 or plans from $25 a month with per-character rates that fall as you move up. For creating voice content, look at ElevenLabs; for putting realtime voice into your own app at volume, compare Inworld's per-character rates.

exit_test.what: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. On 13 November 2026 the session tested Inworld AI on the On-Demand plan: one text to speech clip in the playground and the billing and data retention screens. In the Text-to-Speech playground the voice Sarah, language Auto and model Inworld TTS 2 were used, with sliders for Delivery and Talking speed and MP3 as download format; input is limited to 5,000 characters. A support agent line of 123 characters was entered (it contains a typing error from our side) and Generate was pressed. Audio played within about 3 seconds and the playground reported First audio in 0.8 s, with a clip of 0:05. The 3 seconds is the tester impression, not a timed measurement; the 0.8 s is the playground message. A realtime conversation through the API was not tested because no API key was created. The playground has Add speaker for several speakers and example roles (Support Agent, AI Companion, Fitness Coach, Virtual Assistant, Language Teacher). No timeline or video editor was seen. The MP3 download was not used. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Zero Data Retention cannot be changed on the free On-Demand plan; the setting says an upgrade to Developer or above is needed.

sessions.what: We generated one text-to-speech clip in Inworld AI's playground on the free On-Demand plan on 13 November 2026 and read the billing and data retention screens. The account is Daan's, and our AI assistant did the clicking. We created no API key, so a realtime conversation through the API was not tested. We did not use the MP3 download or test checkout, support or cancellation.
findings: The playground used the voice Sarah, language Auto and the model Inworld TTS 2, with sliders for delivery and talking speed and MP3 as the download format. Input is limited to 5,000 characters. It offers an Add speaker option and example roles such as Support Agent, AI Companion and Language Teacher. We saw no timeline or video editor.

We entered a support line of 123 characters and pressed Generate. Audio played within about 3 seconds by our eye, not timed, and the playground reported 'First audio in 0.8 s' for a clip of 0:05. The two figures measure different things. The 0.8 s is the playground's own message for one short input, not a latency guarantee for an app.

The free credit balance went from $1.00 to $0.99 after that one clip. The plan card says 'Up to 70 min TTS included'. We could not tell whether the included minutes or the credit paid for the clip, and we did not measure the allowance beyond one short generation.

Under Billing, the Data Retention setting says Zero Data Retention is available on the Developer plan and above, and the Developer card lists it. The setting could not be changed on the free plan. The Developer plan costs $300 a month on its card.
The plan cards show monthly prices and a yearly option labelled '2 months free'. We did not read yearly prices or open checkout, so tax, renewal terms and the payable total are unknown.
not_tested: Sign-up on a fresh account (we joined an existing one)
Speech to speech, speech to text, voice cloning, a conversation with several speakers, and any paid plan
The MP3 download, checkout, support, export, roles, downgrade and cancelling
